reviews.title: Lovely App!
reviews.text: The layout is very easy to get used to, and I have never once felt the need to get premium due to quality of life issues. I absolutely love the color options, and the heart is so cute. This made calorie tracking super duper easy, I genuinely cannot thank the developers enough for it!! 🩷

reviews.title: 100% recommend!!
reviews.text: I love this app so much and it’s super easy to count the calories + nutritions in everything.  But i just wish that it had more food choices, i can never find the exact brand of food im eating 😢

reviews.title: Doesn’t work anymore
reviews.text: Worked okay at first, now it can’t even give you grams or ounces for physical food items. How do you expect me to log FOOD with ml? Obviously ai-supportive (the ai doesn’t work anyway). Just kinda pointless, so many bugs and isn’t great at giving you the food items your searching for, even if you say the exact brand name and WHAT it is. Find a different app!

reviews.title: great app except for the search engine
reviews.text: this app is my favorite calorie tracking app yet, I really like the customization options available (though it would be nice if more accent colors could be added 👀) and it’s pretty simple to use and MOSTLY works perfectly fine. the only issue I have with the app is its search engine because sometimes food from certain brands won’t be shown in the search engine one day and could be found the next day or you search up something and you get results only slightly related to what you searched for. the app is still great, it would be nice if this issue could be resolved in the next update though.

reviews.title: sooo cute!!! i have an update idea! :)
reviews.text:
It would be SO cute if like we could have our own diaries in the app🥹 where we could track our weight, measurements, etc!  and if we could add our own photos to the diary for aesthetic reasons :)! 

hope the devs see this!

reviews.title: Not very good compared to other apps
reviews.text: Its personalizable simple interface is what’s most appealing about it, other than that it’s less advanced than other apps and locks some features under subscription when other apps like my net diary offer the same features for free. It also doesn’t allow you to put your age as under 16. Overall solid app, but its drawbacks turned me to other apps. Its interface is very well done and easy to use but in terms of function it’s very basic.

reviews.title: Good use
reviews.text: This app is amazing I pay for the mouthy and it’s absolutely worth it very accurate also

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: This is such a great app for tracking my calories! I find it to be more easier to use and less complicating than other tracking apps (i.e. MyFitnessPal). I love how they also have the grams setting, which is very helpful when tracking with the food scale I have

reviews.title: Great Tracking App - Missing Cholesterol
reviews.text: I really like this app! I paid for premium in hopes of unlocking more nutrition and better features, however I realized there is not an option for cholesterol which is the main reason I’m tracking food, I would really love to see that added!!

reviews.title: okay app, best if you calculate everything yourself.
reviews.text: the app portrays incorrect weekly and monthly limits, with mine displaying a weekly limit of 7,200 calories—my deficit is 1,200.—it’s mostly good for keeping track of your daily calories as you input them yourself.

reviews.title: AMAZING BRO
reviews.text: I am so ECSTATIC I discovered this nutrition tracker app. It doesn’t require an 80 dollar subscription to track a basic diet. MYFITNESSPAL SUCKS. I am so grateful I get fantastic benefits for free. Your search is over!! Download this app you won’t regret it! Bonus: the theme is so cute!!

reviews.title: Good Tracking App
reviews.text: I think this app is really good for being able to track your calories and to customize its look, although there are a few things I would change to make this app 5 stars. For example adding a way to tell the app you’re finished logging for the day to not lose your streak if you’re fasting, a way to see what you’ve logged for the day on your Home Screen as to edit or remove items, and a graph to log you’re weight loss and see your trends. I use this app instead of LoseIt because of the customization feature, but that app has all of these things I’ve mentioned and makes it a better app overall and I have potential of switching back.

reviews.title: simple app, gets the job done :)
reviews.text:
I really love the small community in this app!! everyone on the forum page is super nice <3
I love the “simple logging” option where you can just log calories and macros if you are unsure of the meal’s contents😸

reviews.title: THE NEW UPDATE
reviews.text: the new update makes it even more difficult to find foods in the search. before, when i couldn’t find what i was looking for there would usually be other options similar to mine, but now when i search something with a brand name, what used to have many variations now has none. i’m better off making an estimate mentally than using this app. i was looking forward to an update on the search database since it needed some improvements, but now it has become almost entirely useless instead. i hope you guys can find a solution to this as i do prefer this app over many other trackers.

reviews.title: always have to pay
reviews.text: I did my research on the app and everyone was saying that the app was free and that was a complete lie because every time I try to track down my food it always says to get premium. They say that most of the app is free including the scanning part but that’s a lie it always tell me to get premium and asks me to pay but I don’t want to have to pay and want to use the app for free. They should put that you have to pay all the time and you are not allowed to use this app for free.

reviews.title: Change Date
reviews.text: Love the app, just please work on fixing the “change the date” option. I’d have to delete stuff and go to the actual date. I think changing the date would be much more convenient.

reviews.title: Barcode scanner and Weight log chart need improvement
reviews.text: When I scan a barcode of a food, I often have to adjust calories and macros to actually reflect nutritional info per serving. I also don’t like how sometimes, even if I enter a weight recording for the day, on the graph there will be days when my weight shows 0.0lb which makes it difficult to visualize progress with the graph going up and down so falsely dramatic. I do overall enjoy the app though.

reviews.title: Great App but Feedback
reviews.text: I love the app however one thing I wish was changed was so the graphs don’t record days you don’t log it. For example, I don’t weigh myself everyday but then it logs it as zero so my graph looks all wonky! Other than that, it’s such a great app and very user friendly!

the app is very cute i love the style personalization and how easy it is to navigate the app the only problem i have with it is that i cant find the foods i have in the search bar, so i wish there was more variety to the foods we log in.

reviews.title: cute and simple

reviews.title: Awesome App
reviews.text: This app is so great. It's super simple to track your calories and there's a free social feature that is really motivating! The ChowTracker team also seems very diligent in responding to users and improving the app

reviews.title: Fix ur app
reviews.text: Almost all of the time the search button doesn’t work, and it is so annoying because how am I supposed to track calories. Seriously do better, it can’t be that hard to fix a search feature

reviews.title: Good but could be better
reviews.text: There are definitely qualities about the app that I like, however i pay for premium features and it doesn’t feel very premium. Multiple time i’ve tried to search something as simple as “broccoli” and the search tells me that they can’t find anything. This glitch happens multiple times and reopening the app doesn’t fix it. I also don’t like how i can’t upload any progress pictures or my current weight.

reviews.title: Bug within 2nd week
reviews.text: The app was working well the first week. But now I can’t search anything that I’ve logged before. It keeps saying it has no search results for food I’ve logged before. I’ve tried redownloading the app twice and restarting my phone and it’s still not working. I love the app but not that it’s not working anymore.

reviews.title: i love ittt!^^
reviews.text: this app has so much customization for everything it even has cute colors u can change too! but sadly i can’t set the cal to 0 i have to have a number more than 0 when i quick add something other than that it soo good <3

reviews.title: Adding foods
reviews.text: Over all not a bad app only thing I wish is that I could save a meal. Like if i make a high protein spaghetti I can add all the ingredients under that one title and it would break it from all the macros and servings under it.

reviews.title: Just what I’ve been looking for
reviews.text: I’ve been looking for a cute calorie app that’s simple as well as motivating and this app has it all. Ive been using yazio but they changed their Interface and it totally made me dislike the app. I love how in this app you can customise the color and shape of the interface as well as the progress section. The food database is also very accurate which is convenient for me. If anything I’d ask for a dark mode but other than that I hope you guys don’t change the interface too much during the next update bc I love it :)

reviews.title: Has so much potential!
reviews.text: I didn’t realize that this was a fairly newer app till I started to do my research on calorie tracker apps. So far my experience has been great as I utilize the bar code scanner a lot & it meets all my needs. I’ll be purchasing a lifetime subscription soon!

reviews.title: Good, but could be better
reviews.text: I really like this app, i downloaded it last week and so far have lost 3 pounds. Sometimes i find it hard to log food because when i search it will not pop up, also when i try to log my current weight it does not let me. The app is overall great but those are the issues i’ve had so far.

reviews.title: Could be way better
reviews.text: It’s okay, but finding foods from a brand can be difficult or you may have to create it on your own. Changing the date on meals you’re trying to log for a different day is impossible you just have to delete it and relog it since there’s so dates to pick from (like this feature is actually broken). I just find it annoying? To log stuff. Especially brand name stuff like yogurt. If it sees one serving as 3/4 cups you can’t alter that to be 100g you have to do some math to figure out what extra fraction of 3/4 you ate so you can log something like 1/ 34 / 2 cups or something weird like that. Just could be better.

reviews.title: Add option for 3rd shift users
reviews.text: So far I really enjoy the app but when I go to log in my food from 11pm to 7 am it of course counts it as a different day. I’m still able to work around it but just wanted to bring it some more attention. When I’m eating my lunch it tries to put it in for a snack 😅
